nodes.title: Fix import/export mismatches that break tsc
nodes.summary: A TypeScript check of the project reports three module errors that will fail `npm run build` at the `tsc -b` step. AppsPage.tsx and AppFormModal.tsx default-import Modal, but src/components/Modal.tsx only has the named export `Modal`. DataPage.tsx default-imports SnapshotHistory, but src/features/data/SnapshotHistory.tsx only has the named export `SnapshotHistory`. Align these imports and exports so the modules resolve, following the named-import style TeamPage.tsx and MemberFormModal.tsx already use for Modal. Covers [fb_8148da89-77a9-40d7-8dd2-6eb7b14905ea].
